svg.desc: Synthetic learning-trajectory plot. The horizontal axis shows training epochs 0 through 30 and the vertical axis task success from 40 to 85 percent. Gray dashed circles identify Baseline, orange dotted triangles Context, and blue solid squares Proposed. All three mean curves increase, with Proposed highest at every observed epoch. From epoch 0 to 30, means change from 43.745 to 57.881 percent, 53.495 to 69.476 percent, and 62.661 to 79.048 percent, respectively. Error bars and translucent bands show sample SD across six runs per method.
svg.title: Synthetic learning trajectories
